description: This file defines the REST API resource class 'SavingsProductsApiResource' for managing savings products in the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for creating, updating, retrieving, listing, and deleting savings products, with detailed annotations for Swagger documentation and method implementations that interact with underlying services and data models.

classes.name: SavingsProductsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing savings products, providing endpoints for CRUD operations and templates, with integration to underlying services and annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new savings product using provided JSON payload, delegates to command processing service, and serializes the result.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update an existing savings product identified by productId with provided JSON data.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to list all savings products, supports query parameters for filtering fields.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve details of a specific savings product by productId, including charges and accounting details if enabled.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a template for creating or editing savings products, including default values and options.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to delete a savings product identified by productId.

methods.name: handleTemplateRelatedData
methods.description: Helper method to prepare template data with default options, enumerations, and related lists.
